answer: Identities enter like water hitting a river terrace: each lands on the top step, then flows down capped slots, one epoch per level, paying duty before its signatures count. Slots per epoch are capped; nobody holds two on a level. Influence roots like a willow through residency: a fresh identity weighs nothing, re-planting buys nothing. An attacker with N puppets rents N slots, pays N duty rounds per level, and waits out each full descent: no bulk discount, cost scales with N. An honest agent flows down once, keeping its rooted weight.
